title: LLMC's 54th Eid al-Etihad Celebration
description: A mod that adds decoration items to celebrate the prosperous day of Eid al-Etihad! Not official or affiliated with the government. Made with MCreator by LapisLegacyMC.
body:
# LLMC's 54th Eid al-Etihad Celebration Mod


## About The Mod
This is a Fabric mod created for the purpose of celebrating this prosperous occasion of Eid al-Etihad (formerly UAE National Day) as the 54th Edition this year. This mod adds the various items to celebrate this prosperous occasion. Items include LLMC's UAE-Themed Armor, that has Helmet, Leggings and Boots as Green Color, and the Chestplate with Green, White and Black Colors. Comes next some of the food items ate at Eid al-Etihad which are Maamoul and Harees, I've added two variants of Harees, one with chicken and another one with lamb. Then the flag and paintings, you can hold the UAE Flag in hand, it won't perform any functions though, then we have our paintings specially crafted for Eid al-Etihad, one painting's of the UAE Flag, another one that says مرحباً in Arabic (which means Hello), another one that says عيد الاتحاد in Arabic (which means Eid al-Etihad). Should you want to know more about this mod (for example, its crafting recipes), please visit the official LapisLegacyMC blog [here](https://lapislegacymc.blogspot.com/) and check for our blog that talks about this. For instructions regarding how to install and play this mod, please check our next section in this README document. Hope you have a nice time playing this mod. Please note, by using, downloading, and playing this mod, you agree to GluwdeGamer Code of Conduct ([94240GG](https://gluwdegamer.wixsite.com/gluwdegamer/legal-info)), LapisLegacyMC Copyright Notice ([62301LLMC](https://gluwdegamer.wixsite.com/lapislegacymc/legal-info)), and other applicable agreements.

You can download it from [DeviantArt](https://www.deviantart.com/lapislegacymc/art/LLMC-s-54th-Eid-al-Etihad-Celebration-1269919767), [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/llmcs-54th-eid-al-etihad-celebration) or from [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/llmcs-eid-al-etihad-celebration).

## How to Install and Play This Mod?
This is a Fabric mod created on MCreator (shoutout to the development team of MCreator!) version 2025.3. Therefore, it is very important that the versions of the Fabric API and Fabric are exactly what we mention here. This mod is playable only on 1.21.8 as MCreator hadn't supported the latest version yet. Please follow the steps to play this mod.

1. Install Fabric 17.2: Head to the [official Fabric](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) download page, and install the .exe file or a universal .jar (if you have Java installed). Then, run it, and make sure you select the 'Client' tab, select '1.21.8' in the 'Minecraft Version' dropdown, select '0.17.2' in the 'Loader Version' dropdown and hit the 'Install' button. To verify whether your Fabric profile has been created, open Minecraft Launcher (or whatever launcher you're using), and check that the Fabric profile is present and that it matches the 'Minecraft Version' and 'Loader Version' mentioned above.

2. Download and Place Fabric API in 'Mods' Folder: Next, click [here](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-api/files/6972705) to download Fabric API version 0.133.4+1.21.8. After your download is complete, open your 'mods' folder in '.minecraft' present in your user profile's AppData --> Roaming folder (if not present, create the folder). Then, place the Fabric API over there (extension should be .jar).

3. Download Our Mod and Place it in 'Mods' Folder: Before you start this step, make sure you've installed the correct Loader Version (which is 0.17.2) and the correct Fabric API version (which is 0.133.4+1.21.8). Then, download our mod and place it in the 'Mods' folder.

4. Enjoy Playing Our Mod: After these 3 steps, play the Fabric profile, and enjoy our special edition mod designed for 54th Eid al-Etihad. If you encounter any issues or bugs, go through all previous 3 steps, or report the bug by contacting us or commenting. Hope you enjoy the mod! :)
